fusions.name: Clipped Syllable
fusions.desc: Speaks a single clipped syllable that flies out and deals 7 damage to the first enemy it meets. Holds 3 charges, and each kill gives one back.

fusions.name: Shouted Mid-Stride
fusions.desc: Sends a spoken word at a target up to 8 tiles away, dealing 30 damage, rising to 1.4 times that at full reach, and your allies deal 20% more damage for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Rapid Recitation
fusions.desc: Increases your casting speed by 30% for 12 seconds.

fusions.name: Rehearsed to the Beat
fusions.desc: Every ability you have comes round 10% sooner.
